retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-driven layout featuring a subject against a dark vertical wood fence with high-contrast distressed blue lettering and clean white sans-serif metadata.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-close portrait of a male subject in a blue plaid shirt, positioned off-center against a dark, weathered vertical wood plank fence. The composition is anchored by large, cyan-blue distressed block lettering in the upper right and clean, wide-tracked white sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center to balance large graphic text on the right
Cyan blue text color echoing the blue tones in the subject's plaid shirt
Rough, weathered texture of the wood fence contrasting with the clean skin tones
Distressed, hand-painted title style vs. modern, geometric metadata font
coreInvariants: Vertical dark wood plank background with visible gaps and grain
Cyan blue distressed block lettering with a horizontal underline
Wide-tracked white geometric sans-serif text at the bottom edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium-close shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large cyan title in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move right to the bright blue title, then drop to the white text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark wood fence provides textured negative space for the typography to sit on.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal and brown (wood fence background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan blue (title text and shirt patterns)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright text; medium saturation in the blues.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, jagged edges simulating dry-brush paint
Inconsistent stroke widths for a weathered look
Horizontal underline with similar distressed texture
Square proportions for the main title glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: O character features a horizontal bar through the center
U character is squared off at the base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Rough, expressive display type paired with clean, clinical geometric metadata for professional contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the dry-brush painted look of the title
Provides the clean geometric base for the bottom metadata

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium-close portrait of a man with a beard in a blue plaid shirt, standing in front of a dark, weathered vertical wood fence. Leave the upper right and bottom edge clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, cyan-blue distressed block lettering in the upper right with a matching underline. Add a single line of wide-tracked white geometric sans-serif text along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Is the title text cyan and distressed?
Is the background a dark vertical wood fence?
Is the bottom text white with very wide tracking?
Is the subject positioned slightly to the left?

mustRedesign: Do not use smooth, clean fonts for the main title
Do not use a horizontal wood fence
Do not center the main title

mustAchieve: High contrast between text and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue of the text complements the blue of the shirt
Ensure the wood planks are strictly vertical
Verify the 'O' in the title has the unique horizontal bar
Confirm the bottom text is perfectly horizontal and centered
Check for realistic lighting on the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Vertical Wood Fence + Distressed Cyan Block Title (Upper Right) + Wide-Tracked White Sans-Serif (Bottom)
